_note: Synthetic customer emails to the care inbox of Hollowbrook Home & Garden, a fictional retailer. People, addresses, orders and stores are invented for this recipe.

emails.subject: Where is my order?
emails.body:
Hi, my order LK-204517 was supposed to arrive on Tuesday and the tracking page still says label created. Can you tell me where it is?

Thanks,
Jordan

emails.subject: Refund for my return
emails.body:
Hello,

I returned the patio chair cushions at your Riverside Plaza store on the 3rd and I still don't see the refund on my card. The order number is lk 208 331.

Thanks, Dana

emails.subject: Space heater problem
emails.body:
The space heater I bought at the Cedar Falls store started sparking last night and my son burned his hand on the front grille. Order LK-199402. Has this model been recalled?

Marco Ferreira

emails.subject: Re: Your refund request
emails.body:
This is the third time I am writing about my refund on order LK-210076. If it is not fixed by Friday I am handing this to my attorney.

Pat Lindqvist

emails.subject: Thank you to Sue
emails.body:
Hi there,

Just wanted to say Sue at the Maple Grove store was so helpful finding the right stain for my fence. Please pass it on!

Ruth

emails.subject: Charged twice
emails.body:
Hello, I was charged twice for order LK-207145 and the package still hasn't arrived. Can someone look into this?

Ken Tanaka

emails.subject: Missing rewards points
emails.body:
Hi, the rewards points from my purchase last month never showed up. I should have 640 points by now.

Lena

emails.subject: Please call me
emails.body:
Please call me back about my visit to the Northgate store last weekend.

Grace Osei

emails.subject: Raised garden bed
emails.body:
Hi, how do I put together the cedar raised garden bed I picked up at the Eastport downtown store? The instruction sheet skips from step 3 to step 5.

Sam

emails.subject: Question
emails.body:
Hello, I need some help with something. Could someone get back to me?

T. Brennan

emails.subject: Patio table
emails.body:
The glass top on the patio table from order LK-211904 shattered when I set a mug on it, and a piece cut my child's cheek. What should I do?

Nadia Shah

emails.subject: Ladder collapsed
emails.body:
My husband was injured when the step ladder from order LK-205588 folded under him. We have spoken to a lawyer.

Carol Mbeki
